Wintermoor Commander/attacking-grants-in: Whenever Wintermoor Commander attacks, another target Knight you control gains indestructible until end of turn: the attack trigger never fires -- no target ask and no ability lands (the harness's activate step finds only Pass/Concede after the attack). Observed: the Lightning Bolt after combat destroys the 2/2 Black Knight instead of leaving 3 damage marked (CR 603.2, 702.12b). The CDA toughness half is correct and pinned by the passing sibling scenario.
Static Orb/more-than-two-tapped-only-two: 'As long as Static Orb is untapped, players can't untap more than two permanents during their untap steps' is not enforced (CR 611.3c static): all three tapped Talismans untapped at the next untap step while the Orb was untapped. This is the conditional-static family's untap-step walk (rules/turn.go; Winter Orb, Kismet, Frozen Aether share it), so a fix there covers the class. The sibling scenario 'fewer-than-two-tapped-untap-freely' passes, pinning the normal untap.
